goal: Prevent the reviewer allocator from assigning any provider whose reconciled wrapper preflight is currently unusable, before consuming a sequence or lease.
prohibited_actions: Do not burn a reviewer sequence for an unusable provider
Do not author or apply a database migration
assumptions: Wrapper preflight JSON is authoritative for current usability
Missing or malformed preflight state must fail closed
All allocation paths share the filtered reviewer list
stop_conditions: A provider can still be assigned after reconciled preflight refuses it
Filtering consumes a sequence before a usable provider is selected
A required check proves a regression
